source: Collages generados con IA mediante Codex CLI para esta demo, con referencias de estilo aportadas por el usuario. Fondo verde liso recortado después a transparencia. Son ilustraciones libres, no reproducciones históricas.
style_prompt: contemporary editorial magazine paper collage, handmade cut-paper look. The main figure is a black and white halftone photo of a carved ancient Egyptian stone statue, printed with visible coarse halftone dots, cut out by scissors with slightly irregular edges and a thin pale paper border around the cut. Layered behind and around it: overlapping flat cut-paper shapes in exactly these colors only: coral #ed6f5c, mustard #e9b94a, olive #6e7448, warm bone #f7f1de, ink #15140f. Add cut-out papyrus leaves, fragments of Egyptian temple columns and a pyramid as small black and white halftone clippings, a thin hairline circle, a small dotted matrix, and one thin corner bracket. Soft, subtle paper drop shadows between layers so it reads as physical paper stacked on a table. Matte, print-like, museum catalog calm.

images.osiris.webp: Osiris, the Egyptian god of the afterlife and kingship: a statue head and shoulders wearing the tall atef crown with two side plumes, false beard, holding the crook and flail crossed on the chest.
images.thot.webp: Thoth, the ibis-headed Egyptian god of writing and knowledge: a statue with a long curved ibis beak, head and torso, holding a reed pen and a scribe palette, with a papyrus scroll fragment.
images.anubis.webp: Anubis, the jackal-headed Egyptian god who weighs the heart: a statue with tall pointed jackal ears, head and torso, holding a balance scale with two pans.
images.horus.webp: Horus, the falcon-headed Egyptian god: a statue with a falcon head wearing the double crown of Egypt, head and torso, with a large cut-paper Eye of Horus symbol shape beside it.
images.sekhmet.webp: Sekhmet, the lioness-headed Egyptian goddess of fire: a statue with a lioness head and a sun disk above it, shown only from the head to the upper chest, fully clothed in a high-necked sheath dress with a very wide beaded collar covering the entire chest and shoulders, no bare chest and no breasts visible, with cut-paper flame shapes in coral and mustard around it.
images.hathor.webp: Hathor, the Egyptian goddess of joy, music and feasting: a statue of a woman wearing cow horns with a sun disk between them, stylized carved stone face, shown only from the head to the upper chest, fully clothed in a high-necked sheath dress with a very wide beaded collar covering the entire chest and shoulders, no bare chest and no breasts visible, holding a sistrum rattle, with cut-paper lotus flowers.
images.landing.webp: Osiris enthroned for the landing page: a seated statue in the tall atef crown holding crook and flail, beside a large cut-paper sun disk, a temple gateway with columns, two pyramids, papyrus and a small halftone Nile boat, as a wide panoramic collage.
images.isis.webp: Isis, the protective Egyptian goddess, for the access screen: a kneeling statue fully clothed in a sheath dress with a wide beaded collar, both feathered wings spread wide, wearing the throne-shaped crown.
